title: Demo Portfolio Underwriting Deal File
description: Structured data extracted from an OM + T12 + rent roll. The generator consumes this to fill Underwriting Model TEMPLATE.xlsx. Field names ending in a template named-range match that range exactly (see SCHEMA.md).

property.description: Deal-identifying facts. Source: OM cover/property overview page + county records.

units.description: Must equal rent_roll.units.length once parsed; Checks tab verifies this.

om_source_file.description: Filename of the uploaded OM, for audit trail.

extraction_confidence.description: Per-field confidence from the OM parser (0-1). Low-confidence fields get flagged on the review screen before generation.

assumptions.description: House underwriting rules. Pre-filled with Demo Portfolio's standing defaults; editable per deal on the review screen before generation.

purchase_price_override.description: 0 = derive price from T12 NOI / cap rate. >0 = use this price everywhere instead.

loan_interest_rate.description: Placeholder until a lender quote is obtained.

hold_period_years.description: 1-8. Drives where the sale lands on Debt & Exit, the Dashboard, and the Max Price Solver; the pro forma itself always runs eight years.

other_rental_deduction_pct.description: Concessions/other-deduction assumption. Locked below typical T12 actuals per house policy.

additional_other_income.description: Extra ancillary income not currently charged (parking, pet, storage, etc.), annual $. Layered onto the Other Income line from Year 1, then grown with income growth. 0 = none.

stabilized_occupancy_target.description: Occupancy % the deal is expected to reach (e.g. 0.96). Default: equal to current rent-roll occupancy, i.e. no assumed improvement.

occupancy_stabilize_year.description: Year (1-5) occupancy ramps to the target by. 1 = no ramp, target applies immediately (matches pre-2026-07-13 flat-occupancy behavior).

value_add_units.description: Units planned for interior renovation. Source: OM value-add plan.

value_add_premium_per_unit_month.description: Monthly rent premium per renovated unit. Source: OM value-add plan.

misc_expense_annual.description: One-time expense charged in Year 1 only (does not recur or grow).

renovation_downtime_months.description: Months of rent lost per renovated unit (reno at lease turnover); also drives the offline schedule display. Replaced renovation_duration_months + extra_downtime_months_per_unit 2026-07-22; old keys still accepted.

renovation_online_start_month.description: First month renovated units start coming back online.

benchmark_repairs_maintenance.description: Benchmark $/unit/YEAR for Repairs & Maintenance. House number (2026-08-10). 0 = unused, line falls back to T12; >0 switches Pro Forma to benchmark x units from Year 1, then grows with expense growth.

benchmark_turnover_per_turned_unit.description: Benchmark $ per TURNED unit for Turnover / make-ready (2026-08-10). Written to Inputs, not to the Pro Forma benchmark column: that column charges every unit, so the Pro Forma multiplies this by unit_turnover_rate to get $/unit/yr. 0 = unused, line falls back to T12.

unit_turnover_rate.description: Share of units that turn each year. Drives both the concession estimate and the turnover benchmark conversion above.

benchmark_labor.description: Benchmark $/unit/YEAR for Labor Costs (on-site payroll). House number (2026-08-10).

benchmark_insurance.description: Benchmark $/unit/YEAR for Insurance and Bonds. House number (2026-08-10).

replacement_reserves_per_unit_yr.description: Replacement reserves $/unit/YEAR (2026-08-10). Charged BELOW NOI on the Pro Forma — it does not change NOI, the purchase price, the exit values or the IRR, only cash flow after reserves. Grows with expense growth. 0 = no reserve line.

max_opex_pct_egi.description: House ceiling on total operating expenses as a share of EGI (2026-08-10). Not an input to any formula — Year 1 opex is scored against it on the Checks tab. 0 = not scored.

t12.description: T12 summary line items. Source: uploaded T12 Excel export, mapped by header fuzzy-match. This is what actually drives the model (Pro Forma reads these, not the raw detail below).

repairs_maintenance.description: Controllable sub-section (optional): Total Repairs and Maintenance.

labor_costs.description: Controllable sub-section (optional): Total Labor Costs / payroll.

advertising_promotions.description: Controllable sub-section (optional): Total Advertising and Promotions.

general_admin.description: Controllable sub-section (optional): Total General and Administrative Costs.

management_fee_actual.description: Reference only; model replaces with management_fee_pct_egi.

property_taxes_actual.description: Reference only; model replaces with the county sale-reset tax estimate.

other_property_expenses.description: NOT reference-only: Pro Forma grows this 3%/yr as a Year 1 expense base.

month_headers.description: Optional column labels for the raw monthly detail (e.g. 'Jun 2025'), oldest first. Written to the audit-table header so the months shown match the statement.

raw_monthly_detail.description: Optional GL account-level detail for the audit table. Not used by any formula.

tax.description: County tax roll data. Source: automated county-record web search (with source URLs), else OM tax summary page.

county_source_url.description: URL of the county record the automated tax lookup sourced its values from. Written to the Tax tab's 'County source URL' cell.

tax_rule_note.description: Reassessment-on-sale rule for the jurisdiction, from the automated tax lookup. Written to the Tax tab's 'Tax rule/source URL' cell.

reassessment_on_sale_pct.description: Share of the step-up from current taxable value to purchase price that flows into the new assessment after a sale. Written to Tax!B19; drives the Tax tab AND every column of the Max Price Solver. 1.0 = full reset to purchase price, correct where the state reassesses on transfer (e.g. Florida non-homestead commercial, FS 193.1555); it is the default so pre-2026-08-20 deals reproduce exactly. 0.0 = no reset: Year 1 tax holds at today's taxable value and only grows by tax_growth. Use 0.0 where the state bars sale-triggered reassessment — New Jersey treats reassessing solely because a property sold as unconstitutional spot assessment (Township of West Milford v. Van Decker), so NJ assessments move only on district-wide revaluation. To model a revaluation landing at market in such a state, set 1.0 AND supply current_taxable_value as the EQUALIZED (true) value with current_millage_rate as the EFFECTIVE (equalized) rate, so the current-tax line still reproduces the real bill.

rent_roll.description: Source: uploaded rent roll Excel export.

official_units.description: Unit count per the rent roll's own summary page.

units.description: One row per physical unit. 'occupied_flag' = 1 if rent_charge > 0.

rent_comps.description: Optional. From OM rent-comp pages plus any online-verified additions. Filled/edited on the review screen, not auto-extracted with full confidence.

avg_unit_size_sf.description: String allowed for range descriptions like '550-1,000 (studio-2BR)'.

sale_comps.description: Optional. Auto-searched online (recent closed sales in the metro, with source URLs) merged with any OM comps; user-editable on the review screen. Max 6 (template placeholder rows).
